topic.title: The Diwali car on EMI: what an ₹8 lakh car really costs

cta: Did the dealer get you too? Comment
title: The dealer says ₹8 lakh this Diwali. The EMI says more 🚗
description:
Is that festive car EMI as small as it looks?
An ₹8 lakh car on a 7-year loan at an assumed 9% a year: every EMI added up, computed. No bank or carmaker named; the rate is an assumption. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
